items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations, requiring a manual patch.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This security update resolves a zero-day vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) in Adobe Commerce that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on an affected installation, with active exploitation observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and other issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution and privilege escalation.
